design.coverage: scalar-add, rows-4096, string-1024k; explicit three-question subset
design.loadDesign: one open-loop point at 10 requests/s, at most four in flight
design.repeats: two balanced independent pairs, four fresh JVMs
design.primary: correct end-to-end P50 and correct in-window goodput; P95 descriptive in raw reports
design.samplePolicy: 150 scheduled measurement arrivals per question/arm; 100 correct observations required for the declared P50/goodput metrics
design.calibration: implementation and real runtime calibration are separate; no accepted performance conclusion

limitations: The 5–10 minute range is an unvalidated engineering target, not an ETA or timeout guarantee.
This subset screens scalar, multi-row and 1MiB single-value paths; it does not represent the full eleven-question suite.
P95 in the ordinary HTTP output is descriptive. Reliable P99 and small performance differences are not claimed.
Two pairs do not establish repeatability, driver headroom, observer cost or warmup stability.
Correctness, complete trace collection and every planned arm remain required; low samples and quality failures are retained.
The fixed P50/goodput thresholds are preliminary screener settings; statisticsAccepted and performanceAccepted remain false.
